claim: Transfer apps raise and cut what they charge to send money, and keep doing so.
calculation: From data/findings_hours_price_changes.csv (every confirmed price change, one row each): changes per week over the last 28 days, divided by changes per week over the whole file. The ratio is the figure.
window: the last 28 days of the file, against the whole file
min_observations: the file spans at least 28 days and holds at least 50 changes
invalid_if: the finding's last recheck in data/findings.json is more than 3 days old, or the minimum observations are not met
thresholds_text: holds: at least half the all-time weekly rate. weaker: between a tenth and a half. no longer true: under a tenth, or no change in the last 28 days.
trigger: new hourly price rows (the price-change record grows)
proposed_by: Claude, 20 Oct 2026, from ROADMAP.md 'How a finding is tested'; the thresholds are proposals, merged by Seb's 20 Oct rule, and change only through a spec
